'''Aude Bono-Vandorme''' ([[née]] '''Vandorme'''; born 3 August 1962) is a French physicist and politician who represented the [[Departments of France|department]] of [[Aisne]] as member of the party [[La République En Marche!]] (LREM) in the [[National Assembly (France)|French National Assembly]]<ref name="Bio">{{Cite web|url=http://elections.interieur.gouv.fr/legislatives-2017/002/00201.html |title=Elections législatives 2017 |access-date=19 June 2017 |work=Ministry of the Interior |language=French}}</ref> from 2017 to 2022.

==Education and early life==
Bono-Vandorme was born on 3 August 1962 in [[Soissons]]. She studied engineering at the École Polytechnique Féminine in [[Sceaux, Hauts-de-Seine]], where she received a doctorate in [[fluid mechanics]].<ref>{{cite book |author= Aude Bono Vandorme |title= Contribution à l'étude numérique et expérimentale de l'écoulement autour d'une sphère |year= 1988 }} {{SUDOC|043792162}}</ref>

==Early career==
Bono-Vandorme subsequently became a faculty member in fluid analysis and mechanics at the École Polytechnique Féminine, as well as a lecturer at the [[Conservatoire national des arts et métiers]] and the [[École Centrale Paris]].<ref>{{Cite web |title= Portraits de Aude Bono et Marc Delatte, élus dans l'Aisne |url=https://france3-regions.francetvinfo.fr/hauts-de-france/picardie/aisne/portraits-aude-bono-marc-delatte-elus-aisne-1281459.html |date= 18 June 2017 |access-date=19 June 2017}}</ref>

==Political career==
===Career in local politics===
Originally a member of the [[Union for French Democracy]] and later a member of [[The Centrists]], Bono-Vandorme was elected to the [[municipal council]] in [[Laon]] in March 2008 on the list of the incumbent [[Union for a Popular Movement]] mayor, [[Antoine Lefèvre]],<ref>{{Cite web |title= Résultat de l'élection municipale à Laon en 2008 |url= https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/Elections/Les-resultats/Municipales/elecresult__municipales_2008/(path)/municipales_2008/002/002408.html |date= |access-date=17 June 2017}}</ref> later becoming the deputy mayor.<ref name="LG"/> In 2010, she ran in the regional elections of [[Picardy]] on the list of [[Caroline Cayeux]],<ref>{{Cite web |title= Liste Envie de Picardie conduite par Caroline Cayeux |url= https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/Elections/Les-resultats/Regionales/elecresult__regionales_2010/(path)/regionales_2010/022/C2022L003.html |access-date=19 June 2017}}</ref> but was not elected.<ref>{{Cite web |title= Élus de la liste " Envie de Picardie " conduite par Caroline Cayeux |url= https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/Elections/Les-resultats/Regionales/elecresult__regionales_2010/(path)/regionales_2010/022/C2022L003.html |access-date=19 June 2017}}</ref> In 2012, Bono-Vandorme ran in [[Aisne's 1st constituency]] under the label of the New Center, and was also nominated by the Union for a Popular Movement. She lost a three-way contest in the second round with 38.60% of the vote, against incumbent [[René Dosière]] with 42.19% and Fawaz Karimet with 19.21%.<ref>[http://www.interieur.gouv.fr/Elections/Les-resultats/Legislatives/elecresult__LG2012/(path)/LG2012/002/00201.html Résultats officiels de la première circonscription de l'Aisne en 2012], on the site of the ministère de l'Intérieur.</ref>

In 2013, Bono-Vandorme became the president of the local branch of the [[Union of Democrats and Independents]] in Aisne. Then, in March 2014, she was re-elected as a municipal councilor in Laon on the list of Antoine Lefèvre.<ref>[https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/Elections/Les-resultats/Municipales/elecresult__MN2014/(path)/MN2014/002/C1002408.html Résultats officiels de l'élection municipale de Laon en 2014], on the site of the ministère de l'Intérieur.</ref> She became the premier assistant mayor,<ref>{{Cite web |title= Délibération N°04 du samedi 29 mars 2014 - Mairie de Laon |url= http://laon.fr/VILLE_LAON_21_WEB/FR/Accueil.awp?page=86&m=4.18.41&a=90.2218 |date= |access-date=19 June 2017}}</ref> a position that she lost in September 2014 following a disagreement with Lefèvre.<ref>{{Cite web |title= Délibération N°01 du lundi 29 septembre 2014 - Mairie de Laon |url= http://laon.fr/VILLE_LAON_21_WEB/FR/Accueil.awp?page=86&m=4.18.41&a=93.2340 |date= |access-date=19 June 2017}}</ref>

===Member of Parliament, 2017–2022===
In January 2017, Bono-Vandorme was chosen by the Union of Democrats and Independents to be a new candidate in Aisne's 1st constituency in the [[2017 French legislative election]].<ref name="FTV2017116">{{Cite web |author = Jennifer Alberts |title= L'UDI ne veut pas faire de la figuration lors des prochaines législatives |url= https://france3-regions.francetvinfo.fr/hauts-de-france/picardie/oise/pays-bray/udi-ne-veut-pas-faire-figuration-lors-prochaines-legislatives-1176273.html |date= 6 January 2017 | access-date=17 June 2017}}</ref> However, an electoral alliance between the Union of Democrats and Independents and [[The Republicans (France)|The Republicans]] in March 2017 caused Bono-Vandorme to lose the party's nomination.<ref name="LU201739">{{Cite web |author= |title= Législatives dans l'Aisne : Un UDI pour quatre LR |url= http://www.lunion.fr/19694/article/2017-03-09/legislatives-dans-l-aisne-un-udi-pour-quatre-lr |date= 9 April 2017 |access-date=17 June 2017}}</ref> Bono-Vandorme did not withdraw her candidacy, choosing to run against The Republicans' candidate Christophe Coulon, and she was suspended from all functions of the Union of Democrats and Independents.<ref>{{Cite web |author= |title= Aisne : Aude Bono suspendue de l'UDI |url= http://www.lunion.fr/25561/article/2017-04-12/aisne-aude-bono-suspendue-de-l-udi |date= 12 April 2017 |access-date=17 June 2017}}</ref>

After her suspension, on 18 April 2017, Bono-Vandorme endorsed [[Emmanuel Macron]] in the imminent [[2017 French presidential election]].<ref name="LU2017418">{{Cite web |author= Samuel Pargneaux |title= Législatives. À Laon, Aude Bono suspendue au candidat Macron|url= http://www.lunion.fr/26505/article/2017-04-18/legislatives-laon-aude-bono-suspendue-au-candidat-macron |date= 18 April 2017 |access-date=27 May 2017}}</ref> She drew closer to [[La République En Marche!]], and on 11 May she won the nomination of En Marche! for Aisne's 1st constituency.<ref name="LREM">{{Cite web|title=Législatives république en marche|url=https://en-marche.fr/article/communique-liste-investis|access-date=11 May 2017}}</ref> She was endorsed by the incumbent René Dosière, despite having run against him in 2012.<ref name="LU2017418"/>

After coming in first in the first round with 28.79% of the vote, in the second round Bono-Vandorme was elected to the French National Assembly for Aisne's 1st constituency with 56.22% of the vote against 43.78% of the vote for Damien Philippot of the [[National Rally (France)|National Rally]].<ref>[http://elections.interieur.gouv.fr/legislatives-2017/002/00201.html Résultats officiels de la première circonscription de l'Aisne en 2017], sur le site du ministère de l'Intérieur.</ref>

In the National Assembly, Bono-Vandorme is a member of the Committee on European Affairs, the Committee on National Defense of the Armed Forces, and the French delegation to the Parliamentary Assembly of the [[Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe]] (OSCE).<ref>{{Cite web |author=Clément Pétreault |title=L'Assemblée nationale et le bal des ambitieux |url=https://www.lepoint.fr/politique/l-assemblee-nationale-et-le-bal-des-ambitieux-12-07-2019-2324205_20.php |date=12 July 2019 |access-date=13 July 2019}}</ref>

In the [[2022 French legislative election|2022 election]], she came second in the first round, and [[List of MPs who lost their seat in the 2022 French legislative election|lost her seat]] in the second round to [[National Rally]]'s [[Nicolas Dragon]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aisne - 1ère circonscription: Résultats des élections législatives 2022 - en direct |url=https://www.francetvinfo.fr/elections/resultats/aisne_02/www.francetvinfo.fr/elections/resultats/aisne_02/aisne_1ere-circonscription |access-date=2022-09-13 |website=Franceinfo |language=fr-FR}}</ref>

==Political positions==
In July 2019, Bono-Vandorme decided not to align with her parliamentary group's majority and became one of 52 LREM members who abstained from a vote on the French ratification of the [[European Union]]’s [[Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement]] (CETA) with [[Canada]].<ref>Maxime Vaudano (24 July 2019), [https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2019/07/24/ceta-qui-a-vote-quoi-parmi-les-deputes_5493039_4355770.html CETA : qui a voté quoi parmi les députés] ''[[Le Monde]]''.</ref>
